title: A Hardware-Trained Generative Quantum Eigensolver for Sample-Based Quantum Diagonalization of Organotin Hydroxides up to 70 Qubits
abstract: arXiv:2611.13755v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Quantum hardware can provide feedback for training circuit generators beyond the reach of exact classical simulation. We train generative quantum eigensolver (GQE) policies, transformers conditioned on molecular descriptors, to generate the state-preparation circuits for sample-based quantum diagonalization (SQD). Training runs first on a noiseless simulator and then with the IBM Heron processor ibm_kobe inside the loop, at 46 and 70 qubits ($1.2 \times 10^8$ shots for the four main training runs). A classical CCSD(T) reference energy of the training molecules enters only an admission gate and two auxiliary reward terms. During hardware training, a reward penalty prevents collapse to circuits that sample only the Hartree-Fock determinant. Policies trained on transition-metal complexes are applied without retraining to Sn(OH)$_3$-Me and its hydrates, minimal models of organotin photoresists for extreme-ultraviolet lithography, from 32 t

translated_title: 面向高达70量子比特有机锡氢氧化物样本型量子对角化的硬件训练生成式量子本征求解器
translated_abstract: 量子硬件可以为训练超出精确经典模拟能力范围的线路生成器提供反馈。我们训练了生成式量子本征求解器（GQE）策略——即以分子描述符为条件的transformer模型——来为样本型量子对角化（SQD）生成态制备线路。训练首先在无噪声模拟器上进行，随后将IBM Heron处理器ibm_kobe纳入训练回路，分别在46和70量子比特规模上进行（四次主要训练运行共计1.2×10⁸次采样）。训练分子的经典CCSD(T)参考能量仅用于准入门槛判断和两个辅助奖励项。在硬件训练过程中，通过奖励惩罚机制防止策略退化为仅采样Hartree-Fock行列式的线路。在过渡金属配合物上训练得到的策略无需再训练即可应用于Sn(OH)₃-Me及其水合物——它们是极紫外光刻所用有机锡光刻胶的最小模型，规模从32量子比特起（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文首次将IBM Heron量子处理器纳入训练回路，在高达70量子比特上硬件训练生成式量子本征求解器（GQE），实现了有机锡氢氧化物分子的样本型量子对角化，且训练好的策略无需再训练即可迁移到新分子体系。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates hardware-trained generative quantum eigensolver (GQE) using IBM's Heron processor in the training loop at up to 70 qubits, achieving sample-based quantum diagonalization of organotin hydroxides with policies transferable to new molecules without retraining.
